messages:
deploy-bot: Attempted deploy of release v2.8.3 to production at 2026-03-20T14:07:10Z. Compliance check: SBOM provenance verification FAILED. Hold placed. Details: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/artifacts/2.8.3/sbom
Alex Chen: Copy — what's missing in the SBOM? Is it just missing signature/provenance or vulnerable packages?
deploy-bot: SBOM fields missing: 'artifact-signature' and 'build-system' provenance. Vulnerability scan completed: no high severity CVEs, several medium (see summary). Full output: 
```
SBOM: MISSING_PROVENANCE
VULN_SUMMARY: 12 medium, 3 low
REPORT: /reports/2.8.3/sbom-report.html
```
Priya Rao: tagging sec oncall @Lina — we need triage. Missing provenance blocks distro compliance for EU customers. Not comfortable approving without signed SBOM. :no_entry_sign:
Lina Gomez: Oncall here. What are rollback options? Can we pin traffic back to v2.8.2 quickly? Change window ends in 2hrs.
Jamal Patel: We can hot-revert the router pin. Run:
```
redwood routes pin --service frontend --version v2.8.2 --reason "sbom provenance missing"
```
That undoes the rollout within seconds. I'll open the rollback PR now.
Alex Chen: Can we instead promote a build that has SBOM provenance (we have 2.8.3+build.5 from CI that includes signatures) or do we need full audit? 
Priya Rao: If you have a signed artifact from CI with matching checksum, we can do an expedited approval. Need signature + provenance url + auditor ack.
Jamal Patel: CI build 2.8.3+build.5 exists but it's not promoted to release tag. To avoid conflicting versions, I'll pin traffic to v2.8.2 and block auto-promote. Then we re-run SBOM gen and attach signature.
Lina Gomez: Sounds good. Also add a note to release notes that the production rollout was paused due to compliance hold and that rollout will resume after signed SBOM.
Alex Chen: I'll draft the release note snippet and push to the release PR.
deploy-bot: Rollback action initiated by Jamal Patel. Command executed: `redwood routes pin --service frontend --version v2.8.2` — traffic routing updated. New status: production serving v2.8.2. :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: Thanks. Please attach the SBOM proof to the release PR and ping me when done. Also add CVE summary to the release notes.
Jamal Patel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/4822 — includes rollback & block on auto-promote. Marked 'compliance/hold'.
Alex Chen: Release notes draft: "Deployment paused — missing SBOM provenance. Rolling back to v2.8.2. We'll reattempt once signed SBOM is verified (sec-reviewed)." I'll update PR.
sec-bot: Security triage requested: ticket #SEC-2026 created, severity: P1 (compliance). Assigned to Priya Rao.
Lina Gomez: We should schedule a short post-mortem for deployment process to catch SBOM omission. I'll create a calendar invite.
deploy-bot: Final status: hold -> rolled_back -> blocked. last_event_ts: 1774501475
